verdict.rationale: Sprinto's quickstart says you can work with your team and your auditor in-platform. Docs also cover selecting an audit partner and validating evidence before audit submission, which suggests audits run inside the product. The auditor-collaboration claim is only a single marketing-level line, with no documented auditor role or scoped view of controls and evidence. Missing for 10: documented scoped auditor role/permissions, a description of the auditor's view of controls and evidence, in-platform auditor request/comment workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that this replaces emailed PDFs.
